method: Every HEAD blob of a retired path was hashed and compared with the immutable archive and every active file. Every file without a byte-identical active copy received a canonical mapping, lexical similarity, exported-symbol/HTTP-method/env/API signature comparison, and a manual classification. All 93 legacy API route paths, 16 page routes, 91 component paths and 19 library paths were checked against the active tree.
